Bindings.Provenance: Alien Mothership bosses (MJ9O children MLOS, MYOS, CCAT, MOOB, EBOT, MEOO list SpawnsExitDevice in MonsterCombatRules.json): the boss's death leaves an Exit Device (301688, ARZPRJ) that returns the team to the start of the ship. An overlay, so it runs beside a boss's own program such as Mothership_MasterOfSilence.
